page: The Microsoft Azure E4ds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine tailored for applications demanding a generous memory footprint paired with low-latency ephemeral storage. Running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, the instance is powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8573C processor reaching clock speeds up to 4.2 GHz. The configuration allocates 4 vCPUs derived from 2 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, accompanied by 260 MB of L3 cache. Architectural capabilities encompass modern x86_64 extensions, including AVX-512, Intel AMX for matrix math acceleration, and hardware cryptographic instructions such as AES and SHA-NI.

System memory totals 32.0 GB, providing an 8.0 GB per vCPU allocation that reflects the 1:8 ratio standard for Azure memory-optimized tiers. Complementing the compute and memory architecture is a bundled 236 GB NVMe SSD, which provides high-speed scratch space for temporary data, swap, and disk caching without requiring external network-attached volumes for temporary I/O.

Benchmark evaluations reveal balanced single-core execution alongside constrained aggregate parallel throughput. Single-threaded gzip compression ranks in the upper tier at 31.35 GB/s, supported by a mid-range Geekbench single-core score of 1643.0 and a single-core stress-ng metric of 1948.38. Conversely, multi-threaded results, including Geekbench multi-core at 3707.0 and stress-ng multi-core at 3991.37, reflect the inherent limits of a 4-vCPU design. Memory bandwidth benchmarks recorded 36.24 GB/s on uncached 256 MB reads and 25.93 GB/s on writes, positioning raw sustained bandwidth in the lower tier despite the large capacity.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the E4ds_v6 avoids compute overhead by allowing memory-bound services to operate on fewer paid vCPUs while still accessing 32 GB of system RAM. The inclusion of bundled NVMe storage adds utility for ephemeral workloads, though production systems requiring persistent data must account for external storage configurations.

The Microsoft Azure E4ds_v6 is best suited for medium-sized relational databases, in-memory caching solutions, enterprise business applications, and lightweight data transformation pipelines that require stable memory density and local temporary disk performance.
description: Microsoft Azure E4ds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine configured with 4 vCPUs across 2 physical cores on a dedicated 4.2 GHz Intel Xeon 8573C processor. Designed with an 8 GB RAM-to-vCPU ratio, the system integrates 32 GB of system memory and 236 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. The x86_64 architecture incorporates AVX-512 and AMX extensions for specialized compute tasks. Benchmark profiles demonstrate competitive single-core processing and strong single-threaded data compression, though aggregate multi-threaded compute and uncached memory bandwidth remain constrained by the four-vCPU scale. By bundling high-speed local disk storage with high memory capacity per thread, the E4ds_v6 provides balanced cost efficiency for memory-heavy configurations that do not require high thread counts. It is well suited for relational databases, Redis caching layers, web serving, and lightweight ETL workloads.
